title: Wiemer scroll reveals and split text
description: CSS-only scroll reveals in the Wiemer manner: display headings whose letters rise out of a masked line one after another as they enter the window, a smaller split for sublines (30px rise), paragraphs that rise 24px and fade, plain fades, a fade-out as a block leaves, and a parallax drift for pictures inside their frames.
notes: uses animation-timeline: view(); browsers without it, and reduced motion, show everything in place
split text keeps the full text for screen readers and hides the letter spans from them
drift: put wiemerDriftFrame on an overflow-clip frame and wiemerReveal("drift") on a child that is taller than it
